say:0:1830204001:1.text: A flash of silver catches your eye among the mangled bodies, nearly hidden beneath the red flowers growing through them.
say:0:1830204001:1.source_cn: 你在一堆已经被红花寄生、残破不堪的躯体之间发现了一个闪...
say:0:1830204001:1.male: A flash of silver catches your eye among the mangled bodies, nearly hidden beneath the red flowers growing through them.
say:0:1830204001:1.female: A flash of silver catches your eye among the mangled bodies, nearly hidden beneath the red flowers growing through them.

say:1:1830204002:1.text: You pick it up and wipe away the blood. Beneath it is the Temple's crest—this is one of their talismans!
say:1:1830204002:1.source_cn: 你捡起了那个物品，擦去上面的血渍，发现它上面竟然有着圣...
say:1:1830204002:1.male: You pick it up and wipe away the blood. Beneath it is the Temple's crest—this is one of their talismans!
say:1:1830204002:1.female: You pick it up and wipe away the blood. Beneath it is the Temple's crest—this is one of their talismans!

say:2:1830204003:1.text: Shaken by what you've found, you search the bodies once more. Among the belongings, you also find Lightbearer coins, Lightbearer-style pens, and other items commonly used by Lightbearers... even a medal issued by the Lightbearer Empire.
say:2:1830204003:1.source_cn: 震惊之余，你忍不住再次在其中搜索起来。你发现其中不止有...
say:2:1830204003:1.male: Shaken by what you've found, you search the bodies once more. Among the belongings, you also find Lightbearer coins, Lightbearer-style pens, and other items commonly used by Lightbearers... even a medal issued by the Lightbearer Empire.
say:2:1830204003:1.female: Shaken by what you've found, you search the bodies once more. Among the belongings, you also find Lightbearer coins, Lightbearer-style pens, and other items commonly used by Lightbearers... even a medal issued by the Lightbearer Empire.

say:3:1830204004:1.text: ... These people were almost all from the Lightbearer Empire.
say:3:1830204004:1.source_cn: ……这些死者基本都是来自耀光的人。

say:4:1830204005:1.text: With a heavy heart, you respectfully return the Lightbearer medal to the deceased.
say:4:1830204005:1.source_cn: 怀着沉重的心情，你将这枚耀光徽章敬重地放回了死者身上。
say:4:1830204005:1.male: With a heavy heart, you respectfully return the Lightbearer medal to the deceased.
say:4:1830204005:1.female: With a heavy heart, you respectfully return the Lightbearer medal to the deceased.
